story: On November 10, 2026, Maybelline retired its iconic 35-year-old tagline 'Maybe she's born with it. Maybe it's Maybelline.' — replacing it globally with 'Maybe. We're born with it. Maybe. It's Maybelline.' in a campaign fronted by Miley Cyrus; Allure called it the destruction of 'one of the greatest beauty slogans ever written,' saying 'both its rhythm and satisfying payoff are now gone.'
why_funny: One of the most memorised advertising slogans in history, repeated across four decades and every continent, was swapped for a version that reads like someone sat on the period key.
